config.instruct: A native Korean man aged 43, a small-company owner speaking directly to a new colleague. A comfortable middle-to-low male register, with lighter chest resonance and a softly rounded everyday tone. An ordinary approachable uncle: relaxed and unpretentious, with a tiny natural nasal color and a small lived-in rough grain. He keeps his mature male body but speaks with less vocal weight and less authority. His speech is clear and connected, with firm consonants and concise vowels, at a normal brisk conversational pace. Say 사구 씨 distinctly, then invite the introduction with a small friendly questioning lift. Brief pause only, no stretched vowels, no trailing sentence ending. Ordinary human dialogue, not a performance. Keep the sound easy and familiar: no booming baritone, no seductive leading-man polish, no exaggerated nasal caricature, no old-man tremor. Speak only the supplied Korean words.
